_sources.deepgram: deepgram.com/pricing: $200 sign-up credit, no card. Nova-3 streaming is listed between $0.0048 and $0.0077 per minute depending on the source, so the higher figure is used here (checked 24 Nov 2026). Your Deepgram console shows the real balance.
_sources.elevenlabs: elevenlabs.io/pricing/api: Free plan 10,000 credits a month. Flash v2.5 is listed at 0.5 to 1 credit per character, so 1 is used here (checked 24 Nov 2026). Your ElevenLabs profile shows the real balance; credits reset on your sign-up date each month, not on the 1st.
_sources.zar_per_usd: Approximate rate (16.3 to 16.8 across converters, latest dated figures July 2026). Only used to show Deepgram dollar amounts in rand.
_sources.gemini: Google doesn't publish free-tier daily limits; AI Studio shows them per project. 15 requests per minute was confirmed by a real 429. The daily figure is a developer report, not confirmed (checked 24 Nov 2026).
